From: Tess Rowan
To: Owen Pike
Date written: February 21, 1843
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10083
Tess Rowan asked Owen Pike to
send the alder memorandum.

To: Owen Pike
Date written: February 21, 1843
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10083

copy of the alder memorandum,
but the sender was not
recorded.
